authority_gap: Product SSOT §1.2 prioritizes same-interface movement readability and sufficiently frequent numeric observations over pixel-perfect Y, but specifies no maximum useful inter-observation interval. §22.3 leaves accuracy thresholds for later evidence-based choice. Existing report two-second bridges are presentation only, not detector acceptance.
question_verbatim: 유면이 움직이는 구간에서, 실제 Oil 높이가 관측되는 두 점 사이의 목표 간격을 어느 정도로 잡을까요? 명세에는 “충분히 자주”만 정해져 있어 다음 실험의 시간 해상도를 정하려는 질문입니다. 경계가 안 보이는 장면의 값을 보간하거나 만들어 채우지는 않습니다.
recommendation_basis: Conservative development target for resolving changes within a few seconds; existing local official sampling is 2 FPS. This is a proposed user-facing time-resolution target, not demonstrated sufficiency, a fitted operating point or a source-derived label.

proposed_interpretation.applies_to: Oil only, within separately qualified visible moving intervals; no automatic transfer to Foam episode timing or stationary/obscured intervals.
proposed_interpretation.quantity: Elapsed source timestamp between two usable, same-physical-interface numeric observations; not the count of blank rows, rendered bridge length, tracker history or video FPS.
proposed_interpretation.reporting: Report physical wrong-target observations separately, retain all missing/unassessable cases, and preserve leading/trailing missing intervals. Numerics with unverified identity do not certify useful cadence.
proposed_interpretation.unobservable: No numeric deadline authorizes interpolation, carry, an alternate target or a forced scalar. Insufficient source visibility remains unassessable for physical cadence.
proposed_interpretation.not_yet_adopted: No new PASS/FAIL, runtime sampling, temporal window, threshold, old-reference tolerance, product requirement or Windows procedure is changed by this preparation.

decision_needed_for: Freeze a useful observation-cadence target before selecting the next experiment’s temporal scale and usefulness criteria. Measurement and prototype work are not inherently forbidden by the pending question; dependent product/acceptance choices remain unset.
scope: A new use-expectation question, not another source-position/role review. A numerical answer is not a classifier, an O2 acceptance operating point or proof of observability.
